heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1S handles eSUN PLA+ effortlessly out of the box, reaching safe print speeds up to 262 mm/s sustained by an effective volumetric flow rate of 22 mm³/s. No nozzle upgrades are necessary, though cracking the top glass or door is recommended during prolonged printing to prevent chamber heat creep.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (no adhesive required; ensure surface is degreased with dish soap and warm water)
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 22 mm³/s in the filament settings to maintain precise extrusion limits across high-speed toolpaths.
Configure Pressure Advance (PA) factor to 0.022 for the 0.4mm stainless steel nozzle to minimize corner swelling at high acceleration.
Keep Part Cooling Fan between 80% and 100%, and set Auxiliary Part Cooling Fan to 50% to prevent warping on large footprints while ensuring rapid overhang freezing.
Lower outer wall speed to 150 mm/s and set inner wall speed up to 260 mm/s to balance premium surface finish with maximum throughput.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clicking and under-extrusion mid-print (Heat Creep)
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Enclosed chamber air temperature rising above 35°C, causing eSUN PLA+ to prematurely soften inside the extruder gears.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Vent the chamber by propping open the top glass lid or front door by at least 1-2 cm, and ensure the chamber exhaust fan runs at 50% or higher.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: First layer peeling or corner lifting
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Build plate contaminated with skin oils or bed temperature set below the material's glass transition threshold.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Wash the Textured PEI plate with hot water and unscented dish soap, and verify the first layer bed temperature is set to a constant 60°C.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Fine stringing across small gaps and retractions
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Nozzle temperature slightly too high for detailed travel or moisture absorption in the filament.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Drop the print temperature from 220°C to 210°C-215°C and ensure OrcaSlicer wipe on retract is set to 1.0mm.

faq.question: Can I print eSUN PLA+ on the P1S with the door and top lid fully closed?
faq.answer: While short prints will succeed, long multi-hour prints risk chamber heat buildup that causes PLA+ to swell and clog the extruder; venting the lid or opening the door prevents this.

faq.question: Does eSUN PLA+ require a hardened steel nozzle on the P1S?
faq.answer: No, eSUN PLA+ is non-abrasive and runs safely through the stock P1S stainless steel nozzle without causing premature wear.

faq.question: What is the true maximum volumetric flow rate for eSUN PLA+ on the stock hotend?
faq.answer: The stock P1S ceramic hotend easily achieves 20 to 22 mm³/s with eSUN PLA+ at 215°C to 220°C before experiencing under-extrusion.

faq.question: Do I need glue stick on the Bambu Textured PEI plate for eSUN PLA+?
faq.answer: No glue stick is necessary; eSUN PLA+ adheres strongly to clean Textured PEI at 60°C and pops off automatically once the plate cools to room temperature.
